headline: President Prabowo Inaugurates Jade Mosque During Aceh Flag Event
seoTitle: Prabowo Inaugurates Jade Mosque and Observes 24km Flag…
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto visited Aceh to inaugurate the unique Jade Mosque and witness the unfurling of a 24-kilometer Indonesian national flag.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially inaugurated the Baitul A'la Jade Mosque in Nagan Raya, Aceh.
The mosque is reported to be the only house of worship in the world constructed primarily from jade stone.
The visit coincided with the unfurling of a 24-kilometer Indonesian flag, an effort intended to set a new national record.
aiContextParagraph: On November 11, 2026, President Prabowo Subianto traveled to Nagan Raya Regency in the Aceh province for a series of official engagements. During his visit, the President presided over the inauguration of the Baitul A'la Mosque, also known as the Jade Mosque. Local authorities and media reports describe the structure as unique, identifying it as the only mosque globally built using jade as a primary material. In conjunction with the President's arrival and the local commemoration of National Heroes Day, thousands of participants took part in the display of a 24-kilometer-long red and white national flag. This event was coordinated to secure a new entry in the Museum of World-Indonesia Records (MURI). The ceremony drew significant local participation and media attention throughout the region as part of the official itinerary for the President's visit to the province.
whyItIsViral: The story has achieved high viral velocity due to simultaneous reporting from five independent outlets covering the high-profile presidential visit and the scale of the record-breaking display.
